Test PSBTs for tools/ur_psbt_animator.html
All from the "abandon x11 about" test seed (repo files in test/psbt/); no real wallet data.
Paste one line of base64 into "or paste base64 / hex" and press Load text.
The 1 input, 3 inputs and big (4.5 KB) PSBTs are already preset buttons in the page.
Multisig (4, 5, 6): MULTI SIG mode with test/psbt/MSDESC.TXT loaded (IMPORT DESCRIPTOR > FROM SD).

== 1. Single sig, minimal, 279 B (ABANDON.PSB)
   Max fragment 300 or more: one static QR (single part UR).
   No previous transaction: red PREVIOUS TX MISSING screen before signing.


== 2. Account 1, 601 B (sparrow/abandon account 1.psbt)
   Not ours on account 0; signs with account 1 in WALLET > CONFIG.


== 3. Sweep, 882 B (sparrow/abandon sweep.psbt)
   2 inputs, one output to a foreign P2WSH address, no change.


== 4. Multisig 2 of 3, 783 B (MSWALLET.PSB)
   Legitimate change: shown as CHANGE with the descriptor loaded.


== 5. Multisig attack, 783 B (MSATTACK.PSB)
   Same as 4, the "change" has a foreign key instead of B: must NOT be shown as CHANGE.


== 6. Multisig big, 1987 B (abandon multisig.psbt)
   3 inputs with previous transactions, a send over and one under 100,000 sats, change.
   Fragment 60: about 34 parts, the decoder limit is 35; fragment 50 goes over it (must refuse).
